source.author: Tomasz

quote: I’ve done many tests; every time writing the results down and calculating everything in Google sheets.
notes: Primary-source lead dated 2024-12-28 (after the October 16 gem-rate and October 25 byproduct hotfixes). Author says they compared Bismuth, Aqirite, and Ironclaw across ore ranks 1/2/3 and personally wrote results in Google Sheets, but did not publish the sheet, exact processing operations, output items or rank IDs, hit counts, total units, zeros, histogram, input refunds, profession skill/spec, or gameplay build. This records only an unshared candidate original cohort, NOT measured drop evidence; the author's economic conclusion and unspecified input costs cannot supply gold EV. Candidate input IDs for future independent validation: Bismuth 210930/210931/210932, Aqirite 210933/210934/210935, Ironclaw 210936/210937/210938. Do not import source as study, turn unknown data into zero, or reuse previous Reikah/PeaEsk/other source cohorts. Only revisit this source if the author or indexed material supplies the underlying original worksheet.
